# google_design_center_application_template

Application template in Application Design Center.

## Example Usage - Designcenter Application Template Basic


```hcl
resource "google_design_center_application_template" "example" {
  project                 = "my-project-name"
  location                = "us-central1"
  space                   = "example-space"
  application_template_id = "example-template"
  display_name            = "Example Application Template"
  description             = "Managed by Terraform"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `location` -
  (Required)
  The location of the application template.

* `space` -
  (Required)
  The space of the application template.

* `application_template_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID of the application template.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. User-defined display name.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. User-defined description.

* `application_parameters` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Application parameters.

* `composition_type` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Composition type of the template.
  Possible values are: `STANDARD`, `COMPOSITE`.

* `root_input_variables` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Root input variables.

* `root_output_variables` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Root output variables.

* `saas_runtime_context` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. SaaS runtime context.

* `inputs_as_root_module_variables` -
  (Optional)
  Optional. Inputs as root module variables.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template_id}}`

* `name` -
  Identifier. The resource name of the ApplicationTemplate. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/spaces/{space}/applicationTemplates/{application_template_id}`

* `iac_format` -
  Output only. IaC format.

* `serialized_application_template` -
  Output only. Serialized application template.

* `latest_revision` -
  Output only. Latest revision.

* `artifact_location` -
  Output only. Artifact location.

* `create_time` -
  Output only. The time the resource was created.

* `update_time` -
  Output only. The time the resource was last updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


ApplicationTemplate can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template_id}}`
* `{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import ApplicationTemplate using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    location = "<-required value->"
    space = "<-required value->"
    application_template_id = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_design_center_application_template.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import ApplicationTemplate using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template_id}}"
  to = google_design_center_application_template.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), ApplicationTemplate can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_design_center_application_template.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/spaces/{{space}}/applicationTemplates/{{application_template_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_application_template.default {{project}}/{{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template_id}}
$ terraform import google_design_center_application_template.default {{location}}/{{space}}/{{application_template_id}}
```
